headline: Cases of screwworm increase in the US, keeping ranchers on alert
summary: New World screwworm infestations in the United States have surged due to unusually humid and warm weather in the Southwest, the USDA and state veterinarians said.
why: Screwworm is a parasite that harms livestock, and outbreaks can restrict cattle movements and trade, affecting US beef and livestock producers.
